Regulation_Levies_Ontology.reason: These concepts represent distinct but related elements within the import levy regulation system.  Consolidating them into 'ImportLevyRegulation' and 'ExchangeRate' provides a more focused and accurate representation of the legal domain.

Cereal_Levies_Ontology.reason: Both 'Levy' and 'Duty' represent the same legal obligation within the context of import levies. Consolidation simplifies the ontology.

CerealTradeRestrictions.reason: The two classes represent the same concept: a restriction on cereal trade based on specifications. The pattern is simply a description of the restriction.

Anti_Dumping_Regulation_Ontology.reason: All four classes represent essentially the same concept: the anti-dumping duty rate and its definitive form. Consolidation simplifies the ontology and avoids redundancy.
